name: Bloock
summary: Bloock is an 8x8 block-placement puzzle built around one extra move: Shift. Clear lines on consecutive moves to earn a charge, then slide any row or column by exactly one cell; the block that falls off one edge comes back on the other. The campaign runs to 500 levels across 20 regions with ice blocks and bomb countdowns, alongside an endless Classic mode, a Daily Challenge and a weekly tournament. Pieces never rotate, and Shift is earned through play, never sold.
